cli.usage:
Usage: borderless-shatter <subcommand> [options] [--pretty]

With no arguments it starts the resident process; "gui" opens the panel; "mcp" serves MCP over stdio.
The following subcommands talk to the resident, which must be running:

  list-windows [--process P] [--include-hidden] [--only-managed]
  apply <window> [--island LAYOUT/ISLAND] [--monitor N|primary|\\.\DISPLAYn]
        [--offsets LEFT,TOP,RIGHT,BOTTOM] [--delay-ms N] [--no-profile]
  place <window> --island LAYOUT/ISLAND [--game-resolution WIDTHxHEIGHT]
  restore <window>
  restore-all
  list-islands
  profiles get
  profiles set <file.json|-> [--expected-revision R]
  diagnose <window> [--island LAYOUT/ISLAND] [--monitor M] [--observe-ms N] [--keep]
  help, --help

  <window>    --hwnd N  |  --process P [--title T]
  --pretty    indents the output JSON
  profiles set reads the set_profiles parameters (a JSON object) from the file or from stdin ("-").

Exit codes: 0 success (JSON on stdout); 1 the resident returned an error
({"error":{...}} on stdout); 2 usage error; 3 the resident is not responding.
cli.error.profiles_set_needs_file: profiles set needs a JSON file or "-" (stdin)
cli.error.missing_window: missing window: --hwnd N or --process P [--title T]
cli.error.invalid_hwnd: --hwnd expects a positive window handle, not "{value}"
cli.error.body_not_object: "{file}" must contain a JSON object with the set_profiles parameters
cli.error.body_duplicate_key: "{file}" repeats a key more than once: {reason}
cli.error.not_running: Borderless Shatter is not running: start it with borderless-shatter.exe
cli.error.body_utf16: "{file}" is UTF-16 encoded: save it as UTF-8 (PowerShell: Out-File -Encoding utf8)
cli.error.protocol: could not check the Borderless Shatter protocol: {reason}
cli.error.invalid_instance: BORDERLESS_SHATTER_INSTANCE "{value}" is invalid: use 1 to 32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and -, or leave it empty
